**How to falsify it:** Demonstration that mutations in MAP3K8 exclusively lead to loss-of-function phenotypes and that no common downstream effectors or pathway dysregulation can be identified between anencephaly and lung cancer. _(variant: Presence of common variants (AF > 0.01) in MAP3K8 associated with both anencephaly and lung cancer.)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of the NF-kB pathway and MAP3K8 in both a severe developmental disorder and a common malignancy could reveal novel therapeutic targets for lung cancer that leverage insights from developmental biology, or vice versa.
